title: "EMS_MUT_TEST"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(stringi)
library(stringr)
#currently set up to read genome of common bean
chrom_vector<-readLines("PvulgarisLaborOvalle_670_v1.0.fa")

#remove lines that are headers for fasta files by eliminating lines with ">"
chrom_vector<- grep(">", chrom_vector, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)
chrom_vector<-paste0(chrom_vector, collapse = "")
chrom_vector<-DNAString(chrom_vector)
A_positions<-matchPattern("A", chrom_vector, max.mismatch=0, min.mismatch=0, with.indels=FALSE, fixed=TRUE, algorithm="auto")
#collapse position object to just one number for each position
A_positions<-start(A_positions)
G_positions<-matchPattern("G", chrom_vector, max.mismatch=0, min.mismatch=0, with.indels=FALSE, fixed=TRUE, algorithm="auto")
#collapse position object to just one number for each position
G_positions<-start(G_positions)


#set average number of A to T SNPs. distribution is assumed to be normal
A_to_T_AVG<- 50
#also set Standard deviation
A_to_T_SD<-10
A_to_T_amount<-round(rnorm(1, mean = A_to_T_AVG, sd = A_to_T_SD))
#choose locations for A to T SNPs
A_to_T_locations<-sample(A_positions, size=A_to_T_amount, replace=FALSE)
#now replace the letters at these locations
chrom_vector<-replaceLetterAt(chrom_vector, at = A_to_T_locations, letter=rep("T", times=A_to_T_amount), verbose = TRUE)

#set average number of G to C SNPs. distribution is assumed to be normal
G_to_C_AVG<- 50
#also set Standard deviation
G_to_C_SD<-10
G_to_C_amount<-round(rnorm(1, mean = G_to_C_AVG, sd = G_to_C_SD))
#choose locations for A to T SNPs
G_to_C_locations<-sample(G_positions, size=G_to_C_amount, replace=FALSE)
#now replace the letters at these locations
chrom_vector<-replaceLetterAt(chrom_vector, at = G_to_C_locations, letter=rep("C", times=G_to_C_amount), verbose = TRUE)

#set average and standard deviation of number of deletions
num_deletion_AVG<-20
num_deletion_SD<-5
#now select length from normal distribution
deletions_amount<-round(rnorm(1, mean = num_deletion_AVG, sd = num_deletion_SD))

#set AVG and SD for deletion length as well
len_deletion_AVG<-20
len_deletion_SD<-5

#set deletion locations (currently can fail if end of chromosome is chosen and deletion length is too long)
#code will try to delete something that doesnt exist
#this failure is very unlikely in realistic simulations
chrom_len<-nchar(chrom_vector)
del_locations<-sample(1:chrom_len, size = deletions_amount)
del_locations<-sort(del_locations, decreasing = TRUE)

# Generate all random lengths
all_lens <- round(rnorm(deletions_amount, mean = len_deletion_AVG, sd = len_deletion_SD))

# Create a vector of ranges to delete
del_ranges <- IRanges(start = del_locations, end = del_locations + all_lens)
#replace all regions with null
chrom_vector <- replaceAt(chrom_vector, at = del_ranges, value = "")

#set average and standard deviation of number of insertions
num_insertion_AVG<-20
num_insertion_SD<-5
#now select length from normal distribution
insertions_amount<-round(rnorm(1, mean = num_insertion_AVG, sd = num_insertion_SD))

#set AVG and SD for insertion length as well
len_insertion_AVG<-20
len_insertion_SD<-5

#set insertion locations
insert_locations<-sample(1:chrom_len, size = insertions_amount)
insert_locations<-sort(insert_locations, decreasing = TRUE)
#create vector to sample from to create sequence for insertions
nucleotides<-c("A", "T", "G", "C")
for (i in 1:insertions_amount) {
  latest_insertion_size<-round(rnorm(1, mean = len_insertion_AVG, sd = len_insertion_SD))
  latest_insertion<-DNAString(paste0(sample(nucleotides, size=latest_insertion_size, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
  chrom_vector<-replaceAt(chrom_vector, at = insert_locations[i], value=latest_insertion)
}

#set average and standard deviation for number of inversion mutations
num_invert_AVG<-50
num_invert_SD<-5
#select inversion quantity from normal distribution
inversions_amount<-round(rnorm(1, mean = num_invert_AVG, sd = num_invert_SD))
#create vector of locations for inversions
invert_locations<-sample(1:chrom_len, size = inversions_amount)
invert_locations<-sort(invert_locations, decreasing = TRUE)
#set AVG and SD for inversion length
inversion_len_AVG<-10
inversion_len_SD<-1

# Generate all random lengths
all_Invert_lens <- round(rnorm(inversions_amount, mean = inversion_len_AVG, sd = inversion_len_SD))

# Create a vector of ranges to extract
inv_ranges <- IRanges(start = invert_locations, end = invert_locations + all_Invert_lens)

#extract and invert sequences
sequences_for_inversion<-extractAt(chrom_vector, at = inv_ranges)
inverted_sequences<-reverse(sequences_for_inversion)

#replace the original sections with their inverted counterpart
chrom_vector<-replaceAt(chrom_vector, at=inv_ranges, value=inverted_sequences)
#now extract and clean and reformat desired sequence(BAR gene is example here)
gene_vector<-readLines("BAR_gene.txt")
#remove lines that are headers for fasta files by eliminating lines with ">"
gene_vector<- grep(">", gene_vector, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)
 gene_vector<-DNAString(paste0(gene_vector, collapse = ""))
 matchPattern(gene_vector, chrom_vector, max.mismatch=0, min.mismatch=0, with.indels=FALSE, fixed=TRUE, algorithm="auto")

```
